title: ReviewEvent
description: Data contract between the Reviews service (producer) and the ReviewLens platform (consumer). Owner: reviews-platform team. Breaking changes require a new major version and a 30-day dual-publish window.

event_id.description: Unique per emitted event. Used for exactly-once dedup at bronze->silver.

review_id.description: Business key. A review can be created, edited, deleted.

review_text.description: Free text. May contain PII - classified: confidential until redacted.

event_time.description: When the action happened in the source system (UTC). Drives partitioning and late-data handling.
